title: Identify the driver who recorded the fastest lap time during any race held
question: Identify the driver who recorded the fastest lap time during any race held in Spain between 2010 and 2020, and return their full name, nationality, and official introduction URL.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038" AS forename,
       d."XCL_039" AS surname,
       d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
       d."XCL_042" AS url
FROM lapTimes AS lt
INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Spain'
  AND r."XCL_066" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020
ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" ASC
LIMIT 1
